messages:
marco: Heads up — eu-west-1 dedicated reserved pool is saturated. Queue growing and we're seeing admission-control 429s for some requests. No GPU OOMs reported yet.
ops-bot: Alert triggered: reserved_pool_util=100% queue_len=312 avg_wait_ms=1130 active_gpus=128/128
marco: Quick metrics snapshot:
```
reserved_pool: reserved-eu-west-1
pool_util: 100%
queue_length: 312
avg_wait_ms: 1130
active_gpus: 128/128
top_models: gpt4o-rlhf, codegen-16k
```
sasha: Is this caused by a single tenant or many small ones? Any large batch jobs hitting the pool?
marco: Digging.. traffic curve shows spike starting ~03:20 UTC. Top consumer appears to be acct_42 running batch rerank pipelines.
ingrid: Can we scale the reserved pool up? Any capacity available in region?
carmen: Provider status shows no spare A100s in eu-west for next ~12h. We could burst to shared or route overflow to another region. Both have tradeoffs.
ryan: Recommend we throttle non-reserved / free-tier customers immediately and enable fallback routing for lower-priority traffic. Proposed admission tweak:
```
admission:
  reserved_only: true
  soft_quota_non_reserved: 0.2
  fallback: hosted-default
```
kevin: Applied a temporary concurrency cap for free-tier (max_concurrent=1) at 1752001400. Will watch impact.
marco: Noted — after the cap, queue dropped from 312 -> 190 in ~3m. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Note: enterprise SLA routes unaffected by current policy.
ingrid: Can we open a cross-region route to us-west-2 for overflow? Need to ensure model compatibility and KV/cache warming.
carmen: I'll coordinate the route and pre-warm KV caches for top models in us-west-2. Expect some cold-start latency initially.
marco: Routing change applied (gradual): `route-policy reserved-eu->fallback: us-west-2` at 1752001505. Monitoring queue.
sasha: Please also draft a brief status message to affected customers and ping support ops.
marco: Will post on status.redwood.ai and ping support. Created incident ticket INF-2025-387.
ryan: Assigning postmortem owners to ops: ingrid + sasha. :eyes:
kevin: Current numbers at 1752001560: queue=74 avg_wait_ms=420 pool_util=92%
marco: Good progress. Hold on further changes unless queue >150 or avg_wait >800ms. We'll reconvene in 30m.
